changes: Updated convergence_check so META audit containers are excluded from unfinished lifecycle story counting and surfaced through a separate Audit backlog check. Added smoke coverage for DONE, DISCARDED, META, INIT, advisory audit findings, verified high/critical blockers, and legacy missing evidenceState blockers. Resolved B-META-framework-audit:F-004 using official finding_resolve after confirming B-4c38 / 7350e9df fixed it.
usage: Run `node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check` from the repo or worktree after build. The output now has a separate `Audit backlog` row and no longer lists `B-META-framework-audit` under unfinished stories.
expectedOutcome: `convergence_check` shows `代码注释合规` passed, `所有 Story 完成` false without `B-META-framework-audit`, and `Audit backlog` passed unless verified high/critical audit findings exist.
actualTranscript: `node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check` returned `所有 Story 完成`: `5 个 Story 未完成: B-4622, B-4bae, B-6974, B-d7af, B-da5b`; `Audit backlog`: `0 blocking; 4 advisory`; `代码注释合规`: `22 个注释全部合规`; `需求覆盖率`: `100%`.
outcomeDiff: Matches expected. The only remaining non-convergence is this story plus real active INIT backlog; META is separate and nonblocking.
limitations: Does not change whether parked/INIT backlog stories block convergence; B-4622, B-6974, B-d7af, and B-da5b remain intentionally out of scope.
pitfalls: Plain global `koala convergence_check` in this dev session used the main/global entrypoint before merge, so pre-merge verification used `node packages/main/dist/cli.js convergence_check` from the story worktree to exercise the changed dist output.
